votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of May 30, 2024, June 6, 2024, and June 11, 2024, as well as the formal meeting minutes of May 7, 2024, May 21, 2024, and June 4, 2024.
votes.description: Approval of six sets of prior meeting minutes from both work session and formal Council meetings.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items B1 through B4 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on four grant applications (Homeless Shelter Cities Mitigation, COPS Hiring, RMHIDTA, and Law Enforcement Mental Health Wellness Act) and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Resolution 26 of 2024, the donation of certain City computers to benefit disadvantaged communities and low to moderate income families through a digital donation program.
votes.description: Authorizes the donation of up to 500 surplus City computers to disadvantaged and low-to-moderate-income families through the SLC Computers for the Community program.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Public Utilities Revenue Bond, Series 2024A.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the resolution authorizing the issuance of Public Utilities Revenue Bonds, Series 2024A, without taking final action on the resolution itself.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Issuance of Airport Revolving Line of Credit.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the resolution issuing a revolving line of credit of up to $400,000,000 for the Airport Redevelopment Project.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Request to Vacate a Portion of 700 South to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed ordinance to vacate a portion of 700 South adjacent to 717 South 5600 West and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 59 of 2024 (Form Based Zone Corrections Text Amendment).
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance correcting various standards in the Form Based Districts sections of Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code that were found to be incorrect, inconsistent, or incompatible with the chapter's intent.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Projecting Business Signs Zoning Text Amendment to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed ordinance amending projecting business sign standards in commercial and mixed-use districts and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Zoning Text Amendment to Allow Single-Family Attached Dwellings in Select Commercial Zones to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed ordinance allowing single-family attached dwellings in select commercial zones and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 60 of 2024 (Prohibiting Distribution Centers on the Former North Temple Landfill Site).
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance prohibiting distribution centers on the former North Temple Landfill site at 6780 West North Temple Street within the Northwest Quadrant Overlay, adding a new definition for 'Distribution Center.'

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Capital Improvement Program.
votes.description: Closes the second public hearing on the FY2024-25 Capital Improvement Program budget, with final action deferred to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Sports, Entertainment, Culture, and Convention District Text Amendment to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed D4 zoning text amendments supporting the SECC district, including height, setback, use, and sign overlay changes, and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 61 of 2024, approving $75,000 loan for Policy Kings Brewery from the Economic Development Loan Fund, with the Council's intent to move the funds in the coming budget opening and request the Administration process the request expeditiously.
votes.description: Approves a $75,000 EDLF loan to Policy Kings Brewery, LLC, Utah's first Black-owned brewery, located at 925 South Jefferson Street.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (setting public hearing date for Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY2024-25 and approving the Library Board appointment of Tricia Pil).
votes.description: Sets September 3, 2024 as the public hearing date for Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY2024-25, and approves the appointment of Tricia Pil to the Library Board for a term ending June 30, 2027.
